content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGGU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear for the open interview at Shri Govind Guru University, Vinzol-Godhra on 01-12-2026 (Tuesday) at 11.00 hours. Bring self-attested certificates and all supporting documents. The application form format is printed on page 3 of the notice. Attach a self-attested copy of each qualification and of the preliminary exam call letter, result, main exam form and call letter. More information: https://sggu.ac.in/recruitement2.php.
